deep.reconstruction:
The page is not a manuscript sheet. It is a printed lithographed plate, 'Tab. II', from the Göttingen Magnetic Union publication (Gauss & Weber, Resultate aus den Beobachtungen des magnetischen Vereins im Jahre 1837/38). A library stamp (Niedersächs. Staats- u. Univ.-Bibliothek Göttingen) is in the corner.

The plate has two parts.
(a) Time series for 29–30 July 1837, 0h–24h. The upper curve is the horizontal-intensity disturbance, in scale divisions of the bifilar intensity apparatus (1040–1180; smaller numbers mean larger intensity). The lower curve is the declination disturbance, in scale divisions of the magnetometer in the Magnetic Observatory (850–910; larger numbers mean a more easterly position).
(b) A hodograph ('Störungen der erdmagnetischen Kraft'). This plots intensity against declination as a parametric curve labelled with times (e.g. 6h50', 9h45', 14h55'). The legend states that one intensity division is 1/32000 of the total intensity and one magnetometer division is 21 arc-seconds. This is observational geomagnetism, routine for the Gauss–Weber programme.

The only mathematics is pencil scratch in the bottom margin. It continues the algebra of the previous page (5r), which manipulated quantities a, b, c, d, e, k, l, m, n. That page arrived at relations such as (a+b)n/a − (bd/ac)kn = 1 − k and (ac+bc−bdk)/(ac) = (1−k)/n. It appears to come from a 3×3 determinant / linear-network style computation with ratios like ABCE/ABE.

Reconstruction of the pencil lines (modern notation):
(1) ((bd+cd)/(cd))·k − 1 = ((bd+cd)k − cd)/(cd). The machine reading 'bc·k − cd' should, on algebraic grounds, be '(bd+cd)k − cd'.
(2) This quantity is multiplied against the factor (ac+bc−bdk) obtained on 5r. The likely purpose [my inference] is to eliminate n between two expressions: n = ac(1−k)/(ac+bc−bdk) and another involving ((bd+cd)/cd)k − 1. Doing so gives a quadratic in k.
(3) Expanding the product gives
(ac+bc−bdk)((bd+cd)k − cd) = −(b²d² + bcd²)k² + [(ac+bc)(bd+cd) + bcd²]k − (ac+bc)cd.
The pencil shows the k² coefficient as '−bbdd ± bcdd'; the correct sign is −bcdd (likely misread). A fragment 'abce…' may be the start of the k-coefficient (abcd + …). A denominator 'acd' (or ac·cd) is written below.

The exact target equation cannot be fully recovered from the fragmentary marginal notes.
errors: Pencil: k² coefficient transcribed as '−bbdd + bcdd'; the expansion gives −b²d² − bcd². This is probably a misreading, or a sign slip in the scratch.
First pencil line: '(bc·k − cd)/cd' is inconsistent with ((bd+cd)/cd)k − 1. The correct value is ((bd+cd)k − cd)/cd. Likely a transcription error.

transcription_corrections: 'bc·k − cd' in the second pencil line should read '(bd+cd)k − cd' (or 'bdk + cdk − cd').
'−bbdd + bcdd) kk' should be '−bbdd − bcdd) kk' (or '−(bbdd + bcdd)kk').
The printed text is a published lithographed plate (Tab. II, Resultate aus den Beobacht. des magn. Vereins 1837), not Gauss's handwriting; only the pencil margin is manuscript.
